variants.name: A：項目を一覧で選ぶ
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset: ONE full portrait iPhone settings-page screenshot for the Japanese lofi pixel-art focus app in the reference image. The reference is ONLY for the app's warm ivory accent, restrained typography and black-centered mood. Do NOT copy city illustration into settings: settings must have a clean near-black backdrop for readability. No phone hardware frame, no collage, no A/B/C letters, no presentation headings outside the screen. Premium authentic implementable iOS SwiftUI app UI, refined and readable Japanese sans-serif text, warm cream active state, muted warm-white secondary text that remains legible. Generous 24pt side margins, 44pt minimum controls, realistic safe areas. Title at top is ONLY 設定, no English kicker and no subtitle underneath.
Keep existing functionality, no account, no subscription, no notification switch, no invented settings. Existing configuration:
作業時間の確認 has FOUR mutually exclusive modes: なし = 計測時間をそのまま反映; 軽め = 60分以上の作業終了時に確認; 毎回 = 作業終了時に確認; こまめ = 終了時と作業中に確認. Sample selected state is こまめ. This reveals 作業中の確認間隔, selectable 15分 / 30分 / 60分, sample selected 30分.
Other existing content should be reorganized as concise help entries 世界の操作 and 音の調整 under 操作ガイド. A compact 開発者向け disclosure row near bottom represents existing debug-only sample collection and data reset controls; keep them collapsed, no large delete button on main page. No redundant explanatory essay. Footer small LOFI 0.1.0 if space allows. Fixed bottom navigation of three tabs, laptop icon 作業, stacked rectangles コレクション, gear 設定 selected in cream; quietly elevated near-black rounded tab container. No busy scenery, no neon glowing controls, no gradients resembling advertising, no tiny low-contrast gray body text. Strong hierarchy and consistent alignment.Design A: native grouped list refined for a calm black app. Page title 30pt semibold left. Section caption 作業時間の確認. One gently rounded charcoal group containing four generous 60–68pt radio rows with title 16pt medium on first line, concise secondary explanation 13pt on second, radio circle/check at far right; こまめ selected with warm-cream check and a subtle cream-tinted row fill. Hairline separators inset to text. Below a smaller charcoal group containing label 作業中の確認間隔 and three compact 15分 30分 60分 selection pills on a second line, 30分 active. Then 操作ガイド as two concise chevron list rows grouped together; 開発者向け as a subdued separate disclosure. Balanced density so the main settings and guide rows are visible without awkward huge gaps. Emphasize clear readable rows, not a wall of text.
